digest.component_or_area: outbound type mapping and config-driven type skip
propositions: Type mapping must be config-driven per project via a type_map axis in mapping_config, resolving raw local types to Jira target names with fail-closed on undecided syncable types.
Type resolution and fail-closed validation must execute once up-front in compute_outbound_mutations before the mutation loop, not lazily per-ticket.
The per-project excluded set must union the built-in EXCLUDED_SYNC_TYPES with types mapped to SKIP, and must be applied at both outbound_differ mutation consumers.
Rebar-type: annotation labels must be stamped symmetrically with rebar-status: when lossy type collapse occurs, using a reverse Jira-to-local type map for recovery.
Type-map parameter must thread through all three OutboundMapper implementations and both field mappers (Cloud, DC, and shared) to replace coerce fallbacks.
The rebar-type: prefix must be added to all four internal label prefix filters to prevent spurious sync mutations.
